articles.title: 100 billion times smaller than atom, scientists explore 'zeptoverse'

They detected evidence of a rare process involving beauty quarks using the Large Hadron Collider. This discovery allows researchers to explore interactions at a scale around one zeptometre, known as the 'zeptoverse'. Understanding these interactions could lead to insights about dark matter and its unknown particles.

articles.title: Tennessee couple loses land claim despite 30 years of mowing and gardening

Dated to approximately 237 million years ago, this species had a flattened body covered in bony armour. The fossils were found in deep-sea sediments, indicating they lived far from landmasses. Geochemical tests confirmed the strontium isotopes matched those in seawater during the Late Triassic period.
